crossRefs.note: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:
My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
For whoever finds me, finds life, and will obtain favor from Yahweh.
Who can count the dust of Jacob, or count the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last…
who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might…
Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
“Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.

translations.web: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
translations.bsb: Listen to counsel and accept discipline, that you may be wise the rest of your days.
translations.kjv: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
translations.asv: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, That thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
